title: What If Earth Lost Air for 5 Seconds?

segments.text: For 5 seconds, all of Earth's air vanishes.
Instantly, the blue sky turns black, even at noon.
The world goes silent. No air means no sound.
Every plane in the sky loses lift and starts to drop.
The air in your lungs rushes out, and your ears pop hard.
Sunlight hits your skin raw, with no ozone to block it.
And the oceans? With no air pressing down, they start to boil!
Then the air crashes back. 5,000 trillion tons, all at once.
One giant thunderclap, all around the planet.
All of that, in just 5 seconds.
